goals: Verify the ARIMA/RF hybrid controller's ability to handle non-cyclical flash crowd traffic spikes in real time
Verify the system's anti-flapping and smart scale-in behavior during a sudden drop in traffic
activities: Send HTTP GET requests to the frontend root endpoint with a wait time between 1 and 2 seconds
Simulate a stable baseline load of 50 users at a spawn rate of 5 users per second for the first 120 seconds
Trigger a flash crowd spike by increasing the load to 500 users at a spawn rate of 100 users per second from 120 to 300 seconds
Simulate a sudden load drop to 10 users at a spawn rate of 5 users per second from 300 to 420 seconds
End the load test after 420 seconds
